plugin_desc: Innovaphone voice gateway and SBC SNMP child template for devices under PEN 6666. Interface traffic is supplied by the shared VoiceGateway SNMP IF-MIB floor. Proven private telemetry is ISDN l3Table B-channel occupancy (active B-channel gauge, plus configured B channels and calls since boot). CPU, memory, temperature, fan and power-supply health are not published as stable shared objects, so they are not collected. ISDN L2 link state is signalling state and is not treated as host health.
name: VoiceGateway

metrics.name: active_b_channels
metrics.description: Number of currently active ISDN B channels on this L3 instance (l3NumBchanActive, Gauge under PEN 6666 l3Table). The table index is the string l3Label. This is call occupancy, not host health.

metrics.name: configured_b_channels
metrics.description: Number of B channels configured on this ISDN L3 instance (l3NumBchan under PEN 6666 l3Table). Compared with active B channels it shows remaining channel headroom.

metrics.name: calls_since_boot
metrics.description: Accumulated call count on this ISDN L3 instance since the last boot (l3CallsBoot Counter under PEN 6666 l3Table).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
